speaker: Kṣemarāja (sūtra voice)
question: What seals the Heart?
premises: Sūtra 17: middle's opening — knowing-bliss (heart-center via grace).
Sūtra 19: recalling oneness — ever-risen samādhi (recognized, not acquired).
inference: Close in becoming: opening, means, recall, Śiva.
uncertainties: Middle/upāyas/samādhi methods from standard Trika, marked as such.
